messages.text: There are some comments on PR 100 from the expert reviewer, please address
I’ll read the expert comments on PR #100, make the necessary changes, and update the review responses and validation evidence.

The reviewer asks for cumulative material comparisons along radius, |z| and distance from the origin. I’ll add those using the existing Geant4 and validation samples, with narrow |η| slices and normalization over every ray in each slice.

I’m continuing with the nODD review workflow. Geant4 material will accumulate through each recorded step; mapped material will appear at its portal, so the plots can expose shifts in material location.

The new reduction passes analytic tests for partial steps, overlapping material and zero-material rays. It’s now processing both full samples. The plots will use |η| slices of width 0.5: |η|<0.5 for radius, |η|≥1.5 for |z|, and all slices for distance from the origin.

Both full samples have been reduced, and the cumulative endpoints conserve their material totals. The curves expose differences that the final totals hide: the largest sampled forward difference is about 0.36 X₀ near |z|=1.33 m in 1.5≤|η|<2.0. I’ll retain that result alongside the plots.

All five requested figure sets are rendered in PNG, PDF and SVG, with profile data and a comparison table retained. The curves show the barrel’s step-like accumulation and broader forward material shifts. The 36 portable tests pass; I’m preparing the fixed revision for an independent PhysVal check before replying to the reviewer.

The independent review is checking selected cumulative checkpoints and uncertainties directly against the ROOT files. I’m also updating PR #100’s discussion and token records, including the now-finalized parent turn from the earlier mapping work.

PhysVal independently reproduced the sampled cumulative means and uncertainties from both ROOT files, with no blocking defect found. The plots preserve the cumulative endpoint plateaus. I’ll now push the update and reply to the expert with links to all three comparison types.

The report now links all five figures, the data, the uncertainty definitions and the independent assessment. The slices and checkpoint spacing are configurable, and replay checks that it has the matching configuration. I’m publishing the PR update and reviewer response, then checking CI.

The changes are pushed. The GitHub connector can read the review but cannot post replies with its current permissions, so I’m using the repository CLI to publish the response and record it in the interaction ledger.

The [reviewer response is posted](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/100#issuecomment-6416359932), with links to the barrel, forward and origin-distance comparisons. The report also retains the substantial intermediate discrepancies. I’m checking the final pushed head in CI now.
